rationale: Most ground-truth concerns (stage_kv/interface.py physical-geometry, null-block, digest-binding, rank-ack validation) target an earlier, since-rescoped version of the PR and simply don't exist in this diff, capping achievable recall for both. Y independently converges on the two concerns that do carry over — the redundant request-identity validation duplicated across Executor and Runner layers (echoing asukaqaq-s almost verbatim) and the new DiffusionKV DTOs lacking the invariants their #5541 sibling classes enforce (echoing the P1 validation theme) — while X's findings, though well-evidenced and grounded, cluster on latent bugs (DLO fallback, AR-Diffusion runner gap, W0 wiring) that don't overlap with what human reviewers actually flagged. Both are highly grounded and actionable with concrete file/line evidence and reproduction commands, but Y's better alignment with the real reviewers' priorities gives it the recall edge.
